title: Horizon and Colony
author: Isandro Ishikawa
blurb: Vesper Ravensworth, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
